page_title: PAR 3-1 LAZ | Parma v Lazio 01/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+5' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+4' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) jumps into a tackle and Luca Zufferli signals a foul.
90+1' 3 - 1 Enrico Del Prato (Parma) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets into the bottom right corner.
90+1' Lazio are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90' The resulting set piece from Lazio is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) comes onto the pitch so that Nicolo Rovella can be given a rest.
88' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
88' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
87' A cross into the box from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is cleared.
86' Lazio control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
84' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
83' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Matteo Cancellieri and he is replaced by Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manuel Lazzari leaves the pitch and Adam Marusic (Lazio) comes on.
80' 2 - 1 Goal! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
79' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
77' Lazio fail to score from a corner as Zion Suzuki (Parma) leaps to collect the ball.
75' Pedro (Lazio) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

73' A neat pass is well received by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
71' Fabio Pecchia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Hainaut (Parma) replacing Giovanni Leoni.
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Drissa Camara (Parma) is replacing Anas Haj Mohamed.
70' A quickly taken corner by Lazio.
70' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.

67' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lazio.
66' None of the Lazio players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
65' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
64' Botond Balogh (Parma) picked up a yellow card from referee.
63' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
60' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
60' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
57' Parma take a short corner kick.
57' Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Zufferli had an easy-decision to make.
56' Fantastic run and shot from mid-range by Dennis Man (Parma), but a defender denies him an almost certain goal by getting his body in the way.
55' Lazio string together a series of short passes.
53' 2 - 0 Absolutely fantastic goal! Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies into the top right corner. Take a bow.

52' Pedro (Lazio) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
52' The ball goes out of play and Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Here comes a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny is given a rest as he is replaced by Gabriel Charpentier (Parma).
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Baroni decided to make a change. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) is replaced by Pedro.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Mandela Keita (Parma) is replaced by Nahuel Estevez.
46' Referee Luca Zufferli blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' Mario Gila (Lazio) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
45+7' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) duly receives a yellow card.
45+5' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Lazio! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Luca Zufferli and both teams have no complaints.

45+4' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lazio.
45+4' Mandela Keita (Parma) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
45+3' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Luca Zufferli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) and blew his whistle.
42' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
42' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
39' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
39' Dennis Man (Parma) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
36' A pass by Dennis Man (Parma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
35' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
33' Mandela Keita (Parma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
32' Relief for Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

31' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio), but referee Luca Zufferli must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
30' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
29' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lazio comes to nothing.

28' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Zion Suzuki, who makes a glorious save!
27' It looks like Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) saw red with that tackle. Luca Zufferli won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
26' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
22' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) receives a pass then lets rip from long range low towards the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki watches it all the way and makes an easy save.

21' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
18' Ball possession – 41:59.
16' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
13' Lazio fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
12' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
10' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul after Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) hacks down one of his opponents.
9' A precise low pass is received by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
8' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Dennis Man (Parma) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.

6' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
5' The free kick from long range, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
4' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Lazio players look gutted.
3' The Lazio players halt their celebrations as referee Luca Zufferli makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
2' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) produces a remarkable finish after hitting a wonderful first-time shot towards goal from long range and the ball flies inside the left post!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lazio will kick-off.
Luca Zufferli will officiate today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
